text.en:
Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and thirty-eight, as amended, is hereby further amended by
making the words "general manager" and "assistant general manager", wherever they appear in said Act and
its amendments, read "president" and "vice-president", respectively, and wherever the words "president" and
"vice-president" appear, they shall be read "chairman" and "vice-chairman", except in section eleven of said
Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and thirty-eight, where the word president shall be retained in the sense
in which said word is used in the present Act, for the purpose of signing the bonds.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and thirty-three.
Approved, December 3, 1932.
